named_events.loss_description: The impact of Hurricane Matthew on syndicate 623 was modest; affected a number of clients in the south eastern US.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior-year reserve release of $40.8m in 2016 (2015: $40.3m), driven by favourable claims development and reductions in held reserving margins. Specialty lines contributed the largest portion of the releases, followed by property, reinsurance, political risks & contingency and marine. Overall this represented a c.5.9% release relative to opening gross claims outstanding.
raw_causal_phrases: Beazley has a consistent reserving philosophy, with initial reserves being set to include risk margins that may be released over time as and when any uncertainty reduces.
Historically these margins have given rise to held reserves within the range 5-10% above the actuarial estimates, which themselves include some margin for uncertainty.
This margin held above the actuarial estimate was 6.6% at the end of 2016 (2015: 8.2%).
During 2016, we have been able to release prior year reserves of $40.8m (2015: $40.3m).
data.data_quality_notes: All monetary amounts are reported in the native currency of the financial statements (USD) despite field names using '_gbp_m'. Prior-year development was taken from the explicit narrative 'Prior year reserve releases' which states $40.8m (treated as gross). Division-to-LOB mappings were approximated where no exact standard Lloyd's category existed (e.g. 'PCG' mapped conceptually to specialty/professional). The claims development table exists in the notes (gross values) and an aggregate current estimate row was used as the numeric development row; detailed per-development-period numeric rows were not printed in absolute amounts for all ages in a single gross triangle, so the _claims_triangle contains the current gross liabilities row.
